scope: First-party accessibility, performance and source/API security review
manualChecks: All nine public routes and authenticated dashboard tabs reflow at 320px without horizontal overflow
Public and admin skip links move keyboard focus to main content
Mobile navigation opens and closes; Escape restores toggle focus
securityChecks: Captured session cookies are rejected after logout
Public content excludes private version fields and unpublished/future news
Environment, git, library and source-file URLs return 404
Diagnostics reject foreign origins and unexpected fields
Diagnostic size/type allowlists and rate limits
HTML escaping, upload re-encoding, CSRF, OTP expiry and one-use codes covered by regression tests

monitoring.healthSchedule: Every six hours through GitHub Actions
monitoring.ci: Build, tests, source checks and dependency audit
monitoring.notifications: GitHub failure notifications depend on account settings; no external log drain or alert subscription configured

limitations: These are simulated mobile lab measurements, not field Core Web Vitals
Axe DOM checks exclude colour contrast; palette tests and browser audits cover separate aspects
Automated scores do not certify WCAG conformance; independent assistive-technology user testing remains
This review is not independent penetration testing
Admin best-practices score reflects the expected unauthenticated session 401; security protection is retained
